# Check distribution of baseline biomarker by sex and arm
# First, remove sentinel values for analysis
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute mean baseline biomarker by sex
mean_baseline_by_sex = valid_data.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print("Mean baseline biomarker by sex (valid data only):\n", mean_baseline_by_sex)

# Check if baseline biomarker differs by sex
print(f"\nDifference in baseline biomarker between males and females: {mean_baseline_by_sex['M'] - mean_baseline_by_sex['F']:.2f}")

# Check distribution of severity by sex
severity_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nSeverity distribution by sex:\n", severity_by_sex)"}
